resources.string: In the foreground, only the local snapshot refreshes every 5 seconds. No remote check occurs. Values reflect the last read; recovery revalidates them.
Run the currently authorized local rollback?
End this candidate trial and record explicit local rejection. Only the repository-authorized previous state is attempted; it may remain disabled. Quarantined versions are not reinstalled.
Return only to the currently authorized historical target and consume that rollback position. Authorization, expiry and quarantine checks still apply; it may remain disabled.
This local switch uses discovery settings. It cannot override signed security policy, quarantine or missing build configuration.
Roll back to the authorized historical target
No candidate recovery or rollback operation is available now.
No local quarantine records. This does not establish website compatibility.
Local quarantine records have not been read.
Display size, orientation, insets or capture mode changed. Cancel and select again; the old region will not be reused.
Proportional mode: choose a recording region
A proportional diagram of the current default display, not a live preview. System-bar coordinates are included; outer letterboxing is outside the display.
Full display %1$s × %2$s · orientation %3$s° · insets left %4$s top %5$s right %6$s bottom %7$s
Drag inside to move; drag edges or corners to resize. Or select a handle and adjust with direction buttons.

This app requests the full default display. Check the system sharing scope; some devices may override the request. Full capture briefly passes through memory/GPU; only the region is encoded and retained. There is no full-screen file or full-screen fallback after failure.
The region defines proportions only, not an app, page or earlier screen. The later system-authorized frame is cropped to these coordinates; check the consent scope.
This selects the video output region. Internal audio is not bounded by the rectangle and may include other permitted apps. The microphone is not used.
Confirmation saves only this selection. Audio choice and system consent are still required later. Dimension, orientation or inset changes safely stop capture and require a new selection.
Proportional diagram of the full default display including system bars; not app-bound or live
Authorized-frame mode: check the image and select a region
A frozen frame from this consent flow. Encoding and audio capture have not started. It does not follow webpage changes; recording starts only after confirmation.
Preparing the authorized-frame display; recording has not started.
Black frame / wrong source / unwanted: cancel
The full source is fit-centered; outer letterboxing is outside the frame. System-bar coordinates are included. Drag inside to move or edges/corners to resize.

Full authorized content briefly passes through memory/GPU. The frozen frame is not written to files, cache or library, and cannot be exported or shared. Only the confirmed inward-aligned even-pixel region is encoded. Failure does not fall back to full screen.

Internal audio is not bounded by the video rectangle and may include other permitted apps. Confirmation does not prove source identity. System bars, notifications and later frame changes may still be captured.
Backgrounding, lock screen, size changes, ended consent or frame expiry cancels this selection. Request consent again; the old frame cannot be restored.
I checked this authorized frame; confirm region and start
Actual frozen frame from this system consent, not a live preview. Check the source and cancel if incorrect.
